title: ImportExcel Interactive Workflow Map
description: Interactive map of how ImportExcel proper and ImportExcel AI flows move data, plans, scripts, and workbook objects between packages and components.

components.name: User / Prompt
components.description: The caller provides PowerShell commands, source paths, and natural-language prompts.

components.name: File System
components.description: CSV, TSV, XLSX, generated scripts, JSON plans, and report workbooks live here.

components.name: ImportExcel Module
components.description: Loads Public, Private, Charting, InferData, and Pivot scripts and exposes public commands.

components.name: Public Cmdlets
components.description: User-facing commands such as Export-Excel, Import-Excel, Add-PivotTable, Invoke-ExcelPrompt, and Invoke-ExcelAgent.

components.name: Data Readers
components.description: Reads tabular source data from CSV, TSV, or Excel worksheets.

components.name: Dataset Profiler
components.description: Infers column roles and types, samples rows, and creates the DatasetSummary object.

components.name: Report Planner
components.description: Builds the constrained ReportPlan object from dataset facts and prompt intent.

components.name: PSAISuite Bridge
components.description: Resolves PSAISuite and routes prompt calls through Invoke-ChatCompletion.

components.name: Script Generator
components.description: Creates reusable PowerShell scripts and validates model-generated code before saving or running it.

components.name: Report Renderer
components.description: Executes plans and writes data tables, charts, pivots, analysis sheets, and profile sheets.

components.name: Tables & Formatting
components.description: Applies tables, filters, freeze panes, number formats, colors, borders, widths, and styles.

components.name: Conditional Formatting
components.description: Adds data bars, color scales, top/bottom rules, icon sets, and other Excel conditional formats.

components.name: Charts & Pivots
components.description: Creates charts, pivot tables, and pivot charts from worksheet ranges.

components.name: Analysis Sheets
components.description: Creates Executive Dashboard, Statistical Analysis, Correlation Matrix, Summary, and Column Profile sheets.

components.name: EPPlus Workbook Core
components.description: Underlying workbook object model: ExcelPackage, worksheets, ranges, tables, drawings, pivots, and styles.

components.name: Workbook / Script Output
components.description: Final user artifacts: reports, generated automation scripts, expanded plans, and diagnostic files.

components.name: Tests & Examples
components.description: Pester tests and runnable examples validate and demonstrate the flows.

actions.label: Export objects to workbook
actions.summary: PowerShell objects flow through Export-Excel into an EPPlus workbook with tables, formatting, and saved output.

steps.label: Call Export-Excel
steps.passes: PowerShell objects plus path and formatting parameters
steps.annotation: The user controls the workbook surface with switches like -AutoSize, -AutoFilter, -TableName, -BoldTopRow, and -PassThru.

steps.label: Normalize export request
steps.passes: Rows, worksheet name, table options, style options
steps.annotation: Export-Excel handles workbook creation or append behavior and prepares the worksheet write.

steps.label: Create package and worksheet
steps.annotation: EPPlus owns the concrete workbook object model.

steps.label: Apply workbook polish
steps.annotation: Tables, filters, freeze panes, number formats, widths, and colors are applied after values are written.

steps.label: Mutate workbook styles
steps.annotation: ImportExcel wraps EPPlus details in PowerShell-friendly commands.

steps.label: Save package
steps.annotation: Close-ExcelPackage or Export-Excel save behavior persists the workbook.

steps.label: Return artifact
steps.annotation: The user receives either a file, an open workbook, or a package object for additional edits.

actions.label: Import workbook data
actions.summary: Excel worksheet data is read from disk and returned as PowerShell objects for further processing.

steps.label: Call Import-Excel
steps.annotation: The public command is the user-facing read API.

steps.label: Resolve workbook
steps.annotation: The workbook is opened from disk.

steps.label: Open package
steps.annotation: EPPlus loads workbook structure and sheet data.

steps.label: Read worksheet range
steps.annotation: The reader maps worksheet rows back to PowerShell objects.

steps.label: Return objects
steps.annotation: Downstream commands can filter, transform, export, or feed AI report planning.

actions.label: Add pivot and chart
actions.summary: A source worksheet range is summarized with a pivot table and optionally visualized with a chart.

steps.label: Call Add-PivotTable
steps.passes: ExcelPackage, source worksheet, source range, rows, data fields
steps.annotation: The command can create a new pivot sheet when no explicit destination address is supplied.

steps.label: Build pivot definition
steps.passes: Pivot rows, columns, filters, data aggregations, chart options
steps.annotation: ImportExcel translates friendly PowerShell hashtables into EPPlus pivot fields.

steps.label: Create pivot table
steps.annotation: The source range must resolve to a valid worksheet range to avoid workbook repair issues.

steps.label: Add chart if requested
steps.annotation: Pivot charts ride on the pivot table object.

steps.label: Save workbook
steps.annotation: The workbook now contains source data, pivot table, and optional chart.

actions.label: Format data and add rules
actions.summary: Ranges are styled and conditional formatting rules are added through PowerShell-friendly wrappers.

steps.label: Call formatting commands
steps.passes: Ranges, colors, fonts, borders, conditional format rule parameters
steps.annotation: Recent changes allow #RRGGBB color strings in Set-ExcelRange and Add-ConditionalFormatting.

steps.label: Apply static styles
steps.annotation: Set-ExcelRange handles font, fill, borders, alignment, formulas, sizes, and visibility.

steps.label: Apply dynamic rules
steps.annotation: Data bars, color scales, top/bottom rules, and icon sets are created here.

steps.label: Update style model
steps.annotation: ImportExcel keeps callers away from most low-level EPPlus calls.

steps.label: Add worksheet rules
steps.annotation: Excel evaluates these rules when the workbook opens.

actions.label: Inspect dataset
actions.summary: A source file is profiled into a compact DatasetSummary used by AI and deterministic planning.

steps.label: Call Get-ExcelDatasetSummary
steps.passes: Path, worksheet names, delimiter, sample size, analysis rows
steps.annotation: This is the first AI-layer primitive.

steps.label: Load tabular sources
steps.annotation: Workbook sources can include one or more worksheets.

steps.label: Profile rows
steps.annotation: The profiler infers types, roles, examples, missing counts, and suggested number formats.

steps.label: Return DatasetSummary
steps.annotation: This object is compact enough to pass to a planner or script generator.

actions.label: Create report from prompt
actions.summary: The shortest natural-language path: profile data, plan the report, render the workbook.
actions.command: Invoke-ExcelPrompt -Path .\sales.csv -Prompt "Create the data in a table, use data bars, and create a line chart" -OutputPath .\sales-report.xlsx -FallbackToDefault -Show

steps.label: Call Invoke-ExcelPrompt
steps.passes: Source path, prompt, output path, model/fallback switches
steps.annotation: This wraps the full prompt-to-workbook workflow.

steps.label: Summarize dataset
steps.annotation: Dataset facts ground the plan.

steps.label: Plan report
steps.annotation: The deterministic default plan is always available.

steps.label: Optional AI planning
steps.annotation: PSAISuite can produce the ReportPlan; fallback handles failed calls or invalid JSON.

steps.label: Execute ReportPlan
steps.passes: Tables, charts, pivots, conditional formats, analysis sheets
steps.annotation: Prompt intent defaults survive fallback: chart type, data bars, color scales, top/bottom highlights.

steps.label: Create data tables
steps.passes: Worksheet ranges, table names, styles, filters
steps.annotation: Data appears first in the workbook.

steps.label: Create visuals and summaries
steps.annotation: Chart ranges are address strings to avoid empty charts or #REF!.

steps.label: Apply rule-based formatting
steps.annotation: Conditional formats target measure columns.

steps.label: Add analysis tabs
steps.annotation: Executive, statistical, correlation, summary, and column profile sheets are added when requested or useful.

steps.label: Save workbook
steps.annotation: The final workbook is written to OutputPath.

actions.label: Render saved plan
actions.summary: A saved or inspected ReportPlan is rendered later into a workbook.

steps.label: Load plan JSON
steps.annotation: The plan can be inspected, edited, versioned, or generated by AI.

steps.label: Call Invoke-ExcelReportPlan
steps.passes: Plan, source path, dataset summary, output path
steps.annotation: This skips the prompt planning step.

steps.label: Pass executable plan
steps.passes: Tables, charts, pivots, conditional formats, analysis sheets
steps.annotation: The renderer treats AI and deterministic plans the same.

steps.label: Build workbook
steps.annotation: The rendering phase owns workbook layout and artifact creation.

steps.label: Return report
steps.annotation: Useful for CI or repeatable report generation.

actions.label: Generate reusable script
actions.summary: A prompt becomes a reusable .ps1 that can rebuild the report later.
actions.command: New-ExcelReportScript -Path .\sales.csv -Prompt "Create the data in a table and use data bars" -OutputPath .\sales-agent-report.xlsx -ScriptPath .\build-sales-agent-report.ps1 -FallbackToDefault

steps.label: Call New-ExcelReportScript
steps.passes: Source path, prompt, workbook path, script path
steps.annotation: This flow produces automation, not just a workbook.

steps.label: Profile source
steps.annotation: Script generation uses source facts to choose columns, formats, and visuals.

steps.label: Build deterministic fallback
steps.annotation: Fallback preserves chart and formatting intent such as pie charts or data bars.

steps.label: Optional AI script generation
steps.passes: Prompt, paths, DatasetSummary, ImportExcel usage rules
steps.annotation: The model is asked for a complete PowerShell script only.

steps.label: Validate generated code
steps.annotation: Checks include parse errors, bad commands, bad parameters, missing non-switch arguments, and unsafe EPPlus SetColor calls.

steps.label: Write script
steps.annotation: If validation fails and fallback is enabled, the deterministic script is written instead.

steps.label: Return script metadata
steps.annotation: The script is now a reusable artifact.

actions.label: Run agent with fallback
actions.summary: The agent generates a script, runs it, and falls back to deterministic script execution if AI code fails.
actions.command: Invoke-ExcelAgent -Path .\sales.csv -Prompt "Create the data in a table, use data bars, highlight top 3, and create a line chart" -OutputPath .\sales-agent-report.xlsx -ScriptPath .\build-sales-agent-report.ps1 -FallbackToDefault -Show

steps.label: Call Invoke-ExcelAgent
steps.passes: Source path, prompt, output path, script path, fallback switches
steps.annotation: This is the AI-first workflow that keeps automation.

steps.label: Generate script
steps.annotation: The script may be AI-generated or deterministic.

steps.label: Save selected script
steps.annotation: The saved script is what gets executed.

steps.label: Run script
steps.annotation: The script uses ImportExcel commands to build the workbook.

steps.label: Create workbook
steps.annotation: Tables, charts, pivots, summaries, and formatting are applied.

steps.label: Runtime fallback if needed
steps.annotation: If the AI script fails and fallback is enabled, Invoke-ExcelAgent regenerates the deterministic script and runs it.

steps.label: Return workbook and script
steps.annotation: The user gets both the report and automation trail.

actions.label: Analyze existing workbook
actions.summary: An existing workbook is profiled, planned against, and rendered into a new report workbook.
actions.command: Invoke-ExcelPrompt -Path .\existing.xlsx -WorksheetName Sales,Inventory -Prompt "Analyze this workbook and create an executive dashboard" -OutputPath .\existing-report.xlsx -FallbackToDefault

steps.label: Provide workbook and prompt
steps.passes: Workbook path, worksheet names, report prompt
steps.annotation: The flow can target specific worksheets.

steps.label: Read workbook sheets
steps.annotation: Each selected worksheet can become a separate profiled source.

steps.label: Summarize sheets
steps.annotation: The summary includes source names so plans can target the right sheet.

steps.label: Plan analysis
steps.annotation: Executive and statistical prompt intents can add analysis sheets.

steps.label: Render new report workbook
steps.annotation: The source workbook is read; the output workbook is generated separately.

steps.label: Create interpretation tabs
steps.annotation: This is the current bridge toward workbook analysis and repair workflows.

steps.label: Save analyzed report
steps.annotation: The result is a new report artifact, not an in-place edit.
